goal: Verify that a user can create a new Site Host account, navigate to the June 2026 calendar view, and successfully switch to the previous year (2025) using the calendar navigation controls.

findings.instruction: In the top-right corner of the 2026 calendar view, click the left-pointing arrow button (labeled 'Previous year') to navigate to the previous year.
findings.title: Calendar navigation button navigates by month instead of year
findings.description: The instruction was to click the 'Previous year' button to navigate from 2026 to 2025. However, the calendar view changed from 'June 2026' to 'May 2026', indicating the button navigates by month rather than by year. This violates the expected behavior of switching to the previous year.
findings.evidence: In the BEFORE screenshot, the calendar header shows 'June 2026'. In the AFTER screenshot, the header shows 'May 2026'. The year remained 2026, but the month changed, proving the navigation was monthly, not yearly.
reproduction_steps: Log in and navigate to the calendar view.
Click the left-pointing arrow button in the top-right corner of the calendar widget.
Observe that the calendar changes to 'May 2026' instead of 'June 2025' or the full year 2025 view.
